This file guides Claude Code (claude.ai/code) for TD Studios’ luxury Next.js 15 website.

## Stack
- Next.js 15.5.4 App Router; TypeScript strict mode; React 18.
- Supabase/PostgreSQL; Tailwind CSS v3.4.17/PostCSS; Radix UI + shadcn/ui (New York, RSC); pnpm v10.15.1.
- Geist Sans/Mono; Lucide React; Vercel Analytics; Vitest and Playwright.
- Deployment: v0.app → GitHub → Vercel. Project: [v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7](https://v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7).

## Structure
`app/` App Router; `api/` API routes; `components/` reusable components; `lib/` utilities/business logic; `public/` assets; `styles/`; `tests/` E2E tests.

Routes:
`/` homepage; `/work`; `/web`; `/dev`; `/social`; `/design`; `/process`; `/resources`; `/faq`; `/contact`; `/book`; `/support`; `/legal`; `/[client]/signin`; `/clients/[client]`.

API:
- `contact/`: POST contact submission via Resend.
- `chatkit/session/`: POST ChatKit session management via OpenAI.
- `intake/`: POST lead qualification via Supabase.

Important components/files: `sticky-header.tsx`, `nav.tsx`, `footer.tsx`, `glass-card.tsx`, `frosted-button.tsx`, `page-title.tsx`, `section.tsx`, `json-ld.tsx`, `calendly-embed.tsx`, `logo.tsx`, `analytics-provider.tsx`, `ab-test-wrapper.tsx`, `theme-provider.tsx`, `ui/`, `utils.ts`, `analytics.ts`, `ab-testing.ts`, `app/globals.css`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`.

See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md) for complete routing documentation.

## Environment Variables
Create `.env.local` in the project root; see `.env.local.example`:
`RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

## Commands
```bash
pnpm dev            # Start development server (Next.js dev mode on port 3000)
pnpm serve          # Start production server on port 3000 (after building)
pnpm build          # Build for production using Next.js
pnpm lint           # Run Next.js linting with ESLint
pnpm typecheck      # Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files
pnpm ci:verify      # Run full CI verification (lint + typecheck + test)
pnpm report:types   # Generate type error report using custom script
pnpm scan:secrets   # Scan entire codebase for potential secrets using secretlint
pnpm scan:secrets:staged  # Scan only staged git files for secrets (used by pre-commit hook)
pnpm test           # Run unit tests with Vitest (single run)
pnpm test:watch     # Run Vitest in watch mode for development
pnpm test:jest      # Run Jest tests (if applicable)
npx playwright test # Run Playwright end-to-end tests
npx playwright test --ui # Run tests with UI mode for debugging
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts # Run specific test file
pnpm lh:routes      # Run Lighthouse audits on routes using custom script
```

## Testing
Vitest uses jsdom, `tests/setup.ts`, `vitest.config.ts`, `@/` aliases, globals, `*.spec.ts?(x)`, and `passWithNoTests: false`; Playwright files (`**/mobile-layout.spec.ts`, `**/playwright/**`) are excluded. Playwright tests cover mobile centering, parallax, touch targets, viewport handling, and text sizing; screenshots are in `tests/screenshots/`. Default Playwright configuration has no custom config file.

ESLint errors ignored during builds for deployment compatibility. TypeScript build errors ignored for v0.app integration.

## Design
Luxury, dark-first, mobile-first UI:
- Sticky responsive navigation/mobile menu; glassmorphism cards (neutral-900, 70% opacity, backdrop blur).
- `FrostedButton` is polymorphic and analytics-enabled.
- Dark background `oklch(0.145 0 0)`, white text, OKLCH design tokens, light/dark theme, Geist fonts, neutral palette, 0.625rem default radius with sm/md/lg/xl variants.
- Tailwind utilities, responsive breakpoints, accessible focus/hover states, Lucide icons, button variants, optimized iOS Safari viewport handling in `layout.tsx`.
- shadcn/ui: New York, neutral base, CSS variables, RSC enabled.
- Image domains: `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; AVIF/WebP optimization.
- www.tdstudiosny.com → tdstudiosny.com (permanent, 301).

## Analytics and A/B Testing
Track page views, button clicks/location, form success/errors, downloads, bookings, scroll depth, time on page, and CTA position. A/B testing supports structured tests, traffic allocation, active enable/disable, variants, and conversion tracking.

## Authentication
JWT authentication uses `jose`. Each client has `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`; tokens use `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters required). Sign-in: `/[client]/signin`; protected portal: `/clients/[client]`. Token-based sessions prevent unauthorized client data access.

## Development Practices
Use strict typing, `@/*` aliases, proper `"use client"` directives, PascalCase components, kebab-case files, dedicated props interfaces, semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, lazy loading, code splitting, optimized re-renders, CVA variants, and consistent design tokens/glass effects.

## Deployment, Hooks, Security
Use `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Husky hooks install automatically via postinstall. Pre-commit scans staged files:
```bash
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."
```
Pre-push enforces feature branches and scans:
```bash
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }
```
Secretlint uses `<REDACTED_USER>/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`. **Branch Protection**: Feature branch workflow enforced - all changes to main must go through PRs. Console logging in `layout` supports v0.app debugging. Major changes should use v0.app; consider sync implications of direct edits.

## SEO and Documentation
All pages include canonical URLs, OpenGraph, Twitter Card metadata, and JSON-LD. `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`.

Architecture reference: [docs/architecture-map.json](./docs/architecture-map.json), covering stack, Vercel/Cloudflare/Supabase/OpenAI/Resend integrations, DNS/TLS/HTTP verification commands, deployment workflows, missing GA4/GTM/error monitoring/security headers, and enhancement suggestions.
